reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A9C57 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9C57-Camera_UpdateViewCone_17.cpp at sha256 06196a998b52a10aa4d1b3bebb0f51a21e95c9ff3a1574b7f31d9181da02cc66 (recorded implementation.signature: long double __convention Camera_UpdateViewCone_17("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, long param_3, int32_t param_4, int32_t param_5);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_UpdateViewCone_17
retail_function.signature: long double __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, long double arg3 @ st0, int32_t arg4 @ 0xc, int32_t arg5 @ 0x10)
retail_function.summary: Three blocks 0x4A9C57-0x4A9C92: build a 6-word argument block from EAX ([EBP-0x20]), the x87 st0 qword ([EBP-8]), ECX ([EBP-0x1C]), [EBP+0x10], [EBP+0x14]; call 0x4AD371 (Camera_ApplyWideScreen_27) with EDX, &[EBP-0x20], &[EBP+8]; reload st0 from [EBP-8]; if [EBP+8] != 0x27F fldcw [EBP+8]; leave; ret.

candidate_function.signature: long double __convention Camera_UpdateViewCone_17("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, long param_3, int32_t param_4, int32_t param_5);
candidate_function.summary: Transcribes the same call (Camera_ApplyWideScreen_27(arg2, &item_24, &arg_4), 0x27F guard, fldcw, return the qword) but leaves the ECX word uninitialised (`int entity_val; int item_20 = entity_val;`) and declares 5 cdecl parameters.

divergences: ECX argument word is not transcribed: the candidate passes an uninitialised `entity_val` where retail stores ECX at [EBP-0x1C] (0x4A9C63).
Calling convention/argument frame is not preserved: cdecl 5-parameter declaration instead of EAX/EDX/ECX + st0 + [EBP+0x10]/[EBP+0x14].
The EDX first callee argument is not modelled by the candidate.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004A9C57 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9C57-Camera_UpdateViewCone_17.cpp (sha256 06196a998b52a10aa4d1b3bebb0f51a21e95c9ff3a1574b7f31d9181da02cc66). Three blocks 0x4A9C57-0x4A9C92: build a 6-word argument block from EAX ([EBP-0x20]), the x87 st0 qword ([EBP-8]), ECX ([EBP-0x1C]), [EBP+0x10], [EBP+0x14]; call 0x4AD371 (Camera_ApplyWideScreen_27) with EDX, &[EBP-0x20], &[EBP+8]; reload st0 from [EBP-8]; if [EBP+8] != 0x27F fldcw [EBP+8]; leave; ret. Candidate: Transcribes the same call (Camera_ApplyWideScreen_27(arg2, &item_24, &arg_4), 0x27F guard, fldcw, return the qword) but leaves the ECX word uninitialised (`int entity_val; int item_20 = entity_val;`) and declares 5 cdecl parameters.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail is a mixed convention: EAX, EDX and ECX carry three register words, st0 carries a long double, and the remaining two words are stack arguments at [EBP+0x10]/[EBP+0x14]; BN models it as regparm(int32, int32, long double @ st0, int32 @ 0xc, int32 @ 0x10). The candidate declares an ordinary cdecl long double __startOneArgErrorHandling(int, int, long double, int, int), which places arg3 and the ints on the stack and cannot reproduce the register/st0 frame.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail stores ECX into [EBP-0x1C] and passes EDX as the first callee argument. The candidate never transcribes the ECX store: `int entity_val;` is uninitialised and `item_20 = entity_val` passes an undefined word in the third slot of the argument block. The EDX word is also not modelled.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 3 blocks / 3 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 1 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false. The angr block-count difference is a granularity artifact of CFGFast splitting at call returns / rep movsd; the BN and radare2 block and edge tables are identical.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail has one call, 0x4AD371 (Camera_ApplyWideScreen_27), reached with three pushed words; the candidate calls the same symbol with the same 3-argument shape.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: 0x27F control-word guard and the fldcw path match; no other numeric constants.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail writes five stack words before the call (EAX, st0 qword, ECX, [EBP+0x10], [EBP+0x14]); the candidate writes four and leaves the ECX word undefined.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns the st0 qword loaded from [EBP-8]; the candidate returns item_c (`double`), an x87 value, from the same slot.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: st0 in / st0 out and the fldcw side effect on the caller's control word are both present in the candidate; the only float gap is the ABI delivery recorded above.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "long double __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, long double arg3 @ st0, int32_t arg4 @ 0xc, int32_t arg5 @ 0x10)" at 0x004A9C57; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a9c57 (int32_t arg_8h, int32_t arg_10h, int32_t arg_14h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A9C57 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: long double __convention Camera_UpdateViewCone_17("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, long param_3, int32_t param_4, int32_t param_5);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate source defines __startOneArgErrorHandling, not the catalog name Camera_UpdateViewCone_17; the recorded signature does not describe the file.
